case.intent: Show the same amount with different parts

data.title: Making Equal Fractions — Grade 2
data.description: Explore different ways to show the exact same amount on a fraction bar. Split your bar into equal parts and shade them to match!

challenges.instruction: Make a fraction equal to 2/3 your own way: split the bar into equal parts, but not 3, then shade some.
Make a fraction equal to 1/3 your own way: split the bar into equal parts, but not 3, then shade some.
Make a fraction equal to 1/2 your own way: split the bar into equal parts, but not 2, then shade some.
Make a fraction equal to 1/4 your own way: split the bar into equal parts, but not 4, then shade some.
